```{r}
#| label: setup

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, dpi = 500, message = FALSE)

library(r4ss)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

cod_om <- SS_read(here('inst/extdata/models/cod/om'))
cod_ctl <- cod_om$ctl

petrale_om <- SS_read(here('inst/extdata/models/petrale/om'))
petrale_ctl <- petrale_om$ctl

cod_om_rep <- SS_output(here('simulations/cod/no.ind/1/om'), verbose = FALSE, printstats = FALSE)
petrale_om_rep <- SS_output(here('simulations/petrale/no.ind/1/om'), verbose = FALSE, printstats = FALSE)

theme_sleek <- function (base_size = 11, base_family = "") 
{
    half_line <- base_size/2
    theme_light(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) + 
        theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
              axis.ticks.length = unit(half_line/2.2, "pt"), 
              strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA), 
              axis.text = element_text(colour = "grey30"), 
              axis.title = element_text(colour = "grey30"), 
              legend.title = element_text(colour = "grey30", size = rel(0.9)), 
              panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 1), 
              legend.key.size = unit(0.9, "lines"), 
              legend.text = element_text(size = rel(0.7), colour = "grey30"), 
              legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA, fill = NA), 
              legend.background = element_rect(colour = NA, fill = NA), 
              plot.title = element_text(colour = "grey30", size = rel(1)), 
              plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey30", size = rel(0.85)), 
              strip.text = element_text(colour = "grey30"))
}

theme_set(theme_sleek())

pal <- c(rev(LaCroixColoR::lacroix_palette('Orange', 5)), '#EE2C2C')

read_sim_output <- function(filepath, max_grad_criteria = 0.1) {
  scalar <- file.path(filepath, 'ss3sim_scalar.csv') |>
    readr::read_csv() |>
    mutate(scenario = ifelse(scenario == 'no.ind', 'No index_10', scenario)) |>
    tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cols = scenario, delim = "_", names = c('scenario', 'nyr')) |>
    mutate(nyr = as.numeric(nyr)) %>%
    bind_rows({filter(., scenario == 'No index') |> 
        mutate(nyr = 30)})
  
  bad_sims <- scalar |>
    filter(max_grad > max_grad_criteria) |>
    select(iteration, scenario, nyr)
  
  scalar_filtered <- anti_join(scalar, bad_sims)
  
  ts <- file.path(filepath, 'ss3sim_ts.csv') |>
    readr::read_csv() |>
    mutate(scenario = ifelse(scenario == 'no.ind', 'No index_10', scenario)) |>
    tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cols = scenario, delim = "_", names = c('scenario', 'nyr')) |>
    mutate(nyr = as.numeric(nyr)) %>%
    bind_rows({filter(., scenario == 'No index') |> # replicate no index rows for both index lengths (for plotting ease)
        mutate(nyr = 30)}) |>
    anti_join(bad_sims)
  
  dq <- file.path(filepath, 'ss3sim_dq.csv') |>
    readr::read_csv() |>
    mutate(scenario = ifelse(scenario == 'no.ind', 'No index_10', scenario)) |>
    tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cols = scenario, delim = "_", names = c('scenario', 'nyr')) |>
    mutate(nyr = as.numeric(nyr)) %>%
    bind_rows({filter(., scenario == 'No index') |> 
        mutate(nyr = 30)}) |>
    anti_join(bad_sims)
  
  message(paste0(nrow(bad_sims), 
                 ' simulations were filtered out of ', 
                 filepath, 
                 ' due to exceeding the maximum gradient criterion of ',
                 max_grad_criteria,
                 '. They are:'))
  
  return(list(ts = ts, scalar = scalar_filtered, dq = dq, bad_sims = bad_sims))
}

sim_names <- c('cod', 
               'cod_high_sigR_high_sigInd',
               'petrale',
               'petrale_high_sigR_high_sigInd',
               NULL
               )
big_res <- here::here('simulations', sim_names) |>
  `names<-`(sim_names) |>
  purrr::map(read_sim_output)

scalar <- purrr::map(big_res, purrr::pluck, 'scalar') |>
  bind_rows(.id = 'ID') |>
  mutate(species = stringr::str_to_title(stringr::str_extract(ID, '^[:alpha:]+')), # any number of letters starting at beginning
         sigR = ifelse(grepl('_high_sigR', ID), 'high', 'low'),
         sigR_num = ifelse(species == 'cod', 0.4 * (1 + (sigR == 'high')), 0.5 * (1 + (sigR == 'high'))),
         sigRatio = as.numeric(scenario) / sigR_num) |> # warning is about no index scenario
         # + 1) * # = 1 if low, 2 if high
           # ifelse(species == 'Cod', 0.4, 0.5)) |> # these are the baseline sigma Rs for each species
  select(-ID)

dq <- purrr::map(big_res, purrr::pluck, 'dq') |>
  bind_rows(.id = 'ID') |>
  mutate(species = stringr::str_to_title(stringr::str_extract(ID, '^[:alpha:]+')), # any number of letters starting at beginning
         sigR = ifelse(grepl('_high_sigR', ID), 'high', 'low'),
         indexSE = ifelse(grepl('index_se', ID), 'high', 'low')) |> 
         # + 1) * # = 1 if low, 2 if high
           # ifelse(species == 'Cod', 0.4, 0.5)) |> # these are the baseline sigma Rs for each species
  select(-ID)

dq_long <- dq |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(Value.SSB:Value.lnSPB) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = model_run, values_from = value, 
                     id_cols = c(iteration, scenario, year, name, species, nyr, sigR)) |>
  filter(!is.na(em), !is.na(om)) |> 
  mutate(re = (em-om)/om) |>
  group_by(species, nyr, name, scenario, year, sigR) |> 
  summarise(mare = mean(abs(re)),
            mre = mean(re),
            mare_bounds = tibble::as_tibble_row(quantile(abs(re), probs = c(0.05, 0.95)))) |>
  mutate(year = ifelse(species == 'Petrale', year - petrale_om$dat$styr + 1, year))

bad_sims <- purrr::map(big_res, purrr::pluck, 'bad_sims') |>
  bind_rows(.id = 'ID')
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-exploit
#| fig-cap: "Fishing mortality rates for the operating models (a), and example catch time series for a single iteration of both operating models (b, c)."

exploitation <- petrale_om_rep$exploitation |>
  select(Yr, North, South) |>
  filter(Yr <= 2034) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -Yr, names_to = 'Fleet', values_to = 'exploitation') |>
  mutate(Fleet = ifelse(Fleet == 'North', 'Petrale fishery1', 'Petrale fishery2'),
         Yr = Yr - 1922) |>
  bind_rows(tibble(Yr = c(0, 25, 26, 112), Fleet = 'Cod', exploitation = c(0, 0, 0.1052, 0.1052))) |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = Yr, y = exploitation, col = Fleet, group = Fleet)) +
  labs(x = 'Year', y = expression(paste('Fishing mortality rate (', yr^{-1}, ')'))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#595959FF', inauguration::inauguration(name = 'inauguration_2021', n = 3)[2:3])) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = '(a)', hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5) 

petrale_catch <- petrale_om_rep$catch |>
  filter(dead_bio > 0) |>
  mutate(Yr = Yr - 1922,
         Fleet_Name = ifelse(Fleet_Name == 'North', 'Fishery1', 'Fishery2')) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(x = Yr, y = dead_bio, fill = Fleet_Name)) +
  labs(x = 'Year', y = 'Petrale catch (mt)', fill = 'Fleet') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = inauguration::inauguration(name = 'inauguration_2021', n = 3)[2:3]) +
  theme(legend.position = 'none') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = '(c)', hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5)


cod_catch <- cod_om_rep$catch |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(x = Yr, y = dead_bio)) +
  labs(x = 'Year', y = 'Cod catch (mt)') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = '(b)', hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5)

cowplot::plot_grid(
  exploitation,
  cowplot::plot_grid(cod_catch, petrale_catch, ncol = 2),
  nrow = 2
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-MSY
#| fig-cap: "Relative error of the estimate of maximum sustainable yield (MSY). Index is included in the final 10 or 30 years of the estimation model. Note different y-axis scales. Red points are medians of the distributions."
p.high_sigR <- scalar |> 
  filter(sigR == 'high') |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = model_run, values_from = TotYield_MSY, 
                     id_cols = c(iteration, scenario, species, nyr, sigR)) |>
  filter(scenario != 'No index' | nyr == 10) |>                    
  mutate(are = abs((em-om)/om),
         rel_err = (em - om)/om,
         nyr = ifelse(scenario == 'No index', 'none', nyr)) |>  
  group_by(scenario, species, nyr) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = scenario, y = rel_err, fill = factor(nyr), group = paste(nyr, scenario))) +
  geom_violin(
    aes(width = after_stat(0.45 * ave(group, x, FUN = \(g) length(unique(g))))),
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +  
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = 'point', color = 'red', position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = 'black') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(inauguration::inauguration(name = 'inauguration_2021', n = 3)[2:3], '#595959FF')) +
  labs(x = 'Index SE', y = 'Relative error of MSY', 
       title = parse(text = '"High"~sigma[R]')) +
  facet_wrap(~ species, scales = 'free_y', nrow = 2) +
  theme(legend.position = 'none',
        strip.text = element_blank(), 
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = rel(0.8)),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(r = 0))

p.low_sigR <- scalar |> 
  filter(sigR == 'low') |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = model_run, values_from = TotYield_MSY, 
                     id_cols = c(iteration, scenario, species, nyr, sigR)) |>
  filter(scenario != 'No index' | nyr == 10) |>                    
  mutate(are = abs((em-om)/om),
         rel_err = (em - om)/om,
         nyr = ifelse(scenario == 'No index', 'none', nyr)) |>  
  group_by(scenario, species, nyr) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = scenario, y = rel_err, fill = factor(nyr), group = paste(nyr, scenario))) +
  geom_violin(
    aes(width = after_stat(0.45 * ave(group, x, FUN = \(g) length(unique(g))))),
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +  
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = 'point', color = 'red', position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = 'black') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(inauguration::inauguration(name = 'inauguration_2021', n = 3)[2:3], '#595959FF')) +
  labs(x = 'Index SE', y = '',
       fill = 'Number of\nyrs of index',
       title = parse(text = '"Low"~sigma[R]')) +
  facet_wrap(~ species, scales = 'free_y', nrow = 2, strip.position = 'right') +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = rel(0.8)),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
        plot.margin = margin(l = 0))

x.title <- cowplot::ggdraw() + 
  cowplot::draw_label("Index SE", x = 0.45, hjust = 0.5, color = 'grey30', vjust = 0, size = 11)

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p.low_sigR +
                              theme(legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 12)))

cowplot::plot_grid(
  cowplot::plot_grid(p.high_sigR,
                     p.low_sigR + theme(legend.position = 'none'),
                     legend,
                     nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1, 1, 0.35)),
  x.title,
  nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(1, 0.1))
```
```{r}
#| label: fig-r0
#| fig-cap: "Relative error of the estimate of the log of unfished recruitment across ratios of index:recruitment variability. Yellow distributions have double the recruitment variability and recruitment index standard error of the corresponding teal distribution. Red points are medians of the distributions."

scalar |> 
  filter(nyr == 10, !is.na(sigRatio)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = model_run, values_from = SR_LN_R0, 
                     id_cols = c(iteration, sigRatio, species, nyr, sigR)) |>
  mutate(are = abs((em-om)/om),
         rel_err = (em - om)/om) |>  
  # group_by(scenario, species, nyr) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(sigRatio), y = rel_err, fill = sigR, group = paste(sigR, sigRatio))) +
  geom_violin(
    aes(width = after_stat(0.45 * ave(group, x, FUN = \(g) length(unique(g))))),
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +  
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = 'point', color = 'red', position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = 'black') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = inauguration::inauguration(name = 'inauguration_2021', n = 3)[2:3]) +
  facet_wrap(~species) +
  labs(x = expression(sigma[I] / sigma[R]),
       y = expression(paste('Relative error of log(', R[0], ')')),
       fill = expression(sigma[R])) +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom', 
        legend.direction = 'horizontal')
```

```{r}
dq_long |>

  scale_color_manual(values = pal) +
  labs(x = 'Year', y = 'Mean absolute relative error\nof relative spawning output', col = 'Scenario') +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  facet_grid(sigR ~ species, scales = 'free_y', labeller = label_parsed) +
  NULL
```
